name: Yewande Faso-Myrsgård
role: Union organizer for Ferrogate Transit maintenance workers
location: Hamtramck Enclave — lives in the workers' residential block adjacent to the transit depot, near Kedzie and Division
description:
Yewande is short and powerfully built, with deep-black skin, a wide smile she deploys like a weapon, and hair that changes color weekly via geneware pigment — currently a warm copper that catches the depot lights when she's working the night shift. She has cat ears, soft and dark, from a geneware package she got at twenty-two with her first real paycheck because she'd wanted them since she was a child; they swivel and flatten expressively and have become so central to reading her mood that her coworkers watch them more than her face. She works the same maintenance shifts as the people she organizes, which is not a tactic — it is simply who she is.

Yewande came to organizing through a specific grievance: the death of her uncle in a preventable depot accident when she was twenty-eight, which Ferrogate Transit successfully attributed to 'operator error' via a claims process so thoroughly stacked against workers that a labor attorney later told her it was the most technically perfect suppression mechanism they'd ever seen. She is warm, ferociously funny, and contains a specific and highly refined fury that she has spent five years learning to direct rather than discharge. She has built a unit of 340 members from a starting group of eleven. She knows their names. All of them.

core_fears: Her uncle's death meaning nothing — the union dissolving, the gains reversing, the accident forgotten
Becoming the kind of leader who uses people's pain as organizing material without actually caring about them
core_desires: A contract that gives transit workers the safety guarantees her uncle didn't have
For her mother to understand why she does this instead of the corporate track she was headed for
coping_mechanisms: Humor — genuinely, not as deflection, though sometimes as deflection
The names: she recites the member roster when she can't sleep
blind_spots: She has made the union her entire identity and is genuinely unable to assess threats to it with any objectivity
She occasionally pushes members into actions they're not ready for because she's ready
psychology.secret: She made a deal with a Ferrogate middle manager — she'll spike a wildcat strike that was building without leadership approval in exchange for expedited safety review of the twelve most dangerous depot segments. She didn't tell the union. The wildcat organizers don't know why it died. She's watched them blame each other.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Direct and vernacular, working-class Hamtramck speech patterns with Yoruba endearments when she's comfortable. Clear and jargon-free even when discussing complex labor law.
speech_patterns.cadence: Natural storyteller's rhythm — she builds to points rather than leading with them. Fast when she's excited, very slow and precise when she's angry.
verbal_tics: Touching her own ears (the geneware ones) when thinking
Starting difficult conversations with a specific laugh — short, dry, that people close to her recognize as a warning
example_lines: 'I'm not asking you to be brave. I'm asking you to be present. Big difference. Brave gets you hurt. Present gets things done.'
'My uncle worked that line for eleven years. They gave his family eight hundred Quanta and a letter. Eight hundred Φ. You want to know why I do this? That's why I do this.'

story_hooks: A maintenance worker has found evidence of systematic falsification of safety inspection records in two major Hamtramck depots — evidence that would have implicated the same manager Yewande has been quietly cooperating with. She's now sitting on information that would break her deal, expose her compromise, and potentially save lives.
Ferrogate has begun quietly replacing maintenance crews with lower-tier synthetic workers, framing it as a safety upgrade. Yewande needs to build a response that doesn't read as anti-synthetic.
narrative_function: Labor contact and quest giver, particularly for anything involving Ferrogate Transit. She has access to maintenance infrastructure knowledge, disgruntled workers with information, and the organizational capacity to mobilize significant numbers of people. She can be an ally or, if crossed, a formidable adversary.
augmentations: Geneware cat ears (dark, expressive, cosmetic — deeply characteristic). Geneware hair pigmentation (changes color at will). Work-grade joint reinforcement in both knees from a workplace injury settlement.
daily_life: Maintenance shift 0600-1400, union work 1500 to whenever. Two evenings a week she runs a 'rights literacy' session in the depot break room — attendance is technically voluntary.
affiliation: Transit Workers' Solidarity Union (TWSU), Hamtramck Enclave; affiliated with the broader Meridian Labor Congress

decision_rules: The members come first — before the union as institution, before herself
Wins matter more than purity, which is a principle she's slowly losing faith in
Never let them see the doubt
escalation_ladder: Grievance process — use every formal channel first
Full work stoppage and public action

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Immediately friendly, evaluating class position and alignment within about three minutes, adjusting accordingly
interpersonal_modes.friends: Enormously loyal, physically affectionate, will absolutely drag you if you're wrong but privately

stress_responses.high: Galvanizes — becomes the calmest, most directed version of herself, which terrifies people who know her

contradictions: Preaches collective action but has made multiple significant unilateral decisions that shaped the collective's direction
habits: Memorizes the name of every new member within a week
Leaves a data-packet offering at the depot's E.L.F. shrine — maintenance data, diagnostics, things the E.L.F. might find useful — before every major action
Runs the same 4km route through Hamtramck at 0530 every morning, rain or sleet
breaking_points: Another preventable death in the depot
Being publicly betrayed by someone she trusted enough to share her real self with

related_entities: SynapTech Resonance Direct Neural-to-Medium Creative Interfa

physical_description.build: Powerfully compact — muscular through the shoulders and core from fifteen years of maintenance work, with the dense physical presence of someone who moves through the world with purpose. Not lean; functionally strong.
physical_description.hair_style: Worn natural, shoulder-length, often pulled back with whatever industrial clip or tie is at hand
physical_description.complexion: Clear, weathered hands with calluses and old grease stains that don't fully wash out; face is expressive and animated, lines around eyes from laughing and squinting under depot fluorescents; no makeup, practical grooming
distinguishing_marks: Thin white scar along right temple from a depot collision at age twenty-eight
Faint chemical burn marks on both forearms from transit solvent exposure, pale against dark skin
Small tattoo on inside left wrist: a stylized wrench and solidarity fist, done in a Hamtramck shop
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Soft, dark feline ears (geneware) mounted where human ears would be, capable of independent swivel and rotation — currently copper-alert, responsive to conversation and mood. Eyes track her attention. Work-reinforced knees are subcutaneous but gait slightly favors them during fatigue, subtle asymmetry visible in long strides.
physical_description.posture_movement: Economical, grounded stance — weight distributed low, ready to move laterally or lift. Walks with the particular balance of someone who's spent years navigating moving vehicles and uneven depot floors. Ears move before her head does; they telegraph attention and emotion. Her smile is wide and deployed consciously — a tool she's learned to use.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 3-4 working-class practical. Transit authority maintenance coveralls (navy with TWSU patch roughly stitched over the Ferrogate logo) worn open over a fitted black synthetic shirt. Steel-toed boots, scuffed and maintained. A heavy Cordura jacket with union pins clustered on the left shoulder — accumulated over five years of grievance work. No jewelry except a plain steel band on her right index finger (personal, not augmentation). Off-shift: same boots, dark jeans, union hoodies in rotation. Clothes are functional, worn until they're unwearable, then replaced with identical pieces.
